rationale: dual_domain_bilateral_n2i-claude-agentic: train_n=200, val_n=6, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, seed=1234, warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, n_iter=400, outer_wall_s=3000, lr=0.005, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=1, rationale=iter-6 CEILING-CONFIRMATION PROBE (seed). Change EXACTLY ONE knob: seed 42 -> 1234. Based on the iter-1 canonical 6-param config (warm_start=True, img_n_bf=proj_n_bf=1, all sigmas at Wagner defaults, n_iter=400) so this is a clean single-knob A/B vs iter-1. This solver has CONVERGED to its 6-param structural ceiling: 5 iters all flat at SSIM ~0.9462 @1, hr 0 (PSNR ~35.6 dB, ~1 dB BELOW the LD-FBP baseline 36.56 dB) -- iter-1 0.946237, iter-2 (img_n_bf 1->3) 0.945237, iter-3 (img_sr 0.02->0.005) 0.946177, iter-4 (proj_sr 0.02->0.0005) 0.945745, iter-5 (warm_start off) 0.945955. Every sigma/depth/warm_start lever is exhausted and INERT or HARMFUL. This matches the documented dd-bf-supervised structural ceiling (capped 0.9502 with the SAME 6 BF params, every scalar flat). FAILURE MODE (structural, not a tuning miss): the 6-param bilateral cannot beat an already-clean dense-view (2304-angle) FBP -- the half-view N2I information loss (the per-scan fit only ever sees a 1152-angle subset of each scan) exceeds what 6 trainable bilateral params can denoise, so no init or sigma setting clears hr=0. The remaining iters to the iter-20 goal are CEILING DOCUMENTATION, not optimization. THIS PROBE: seed 42->1234 re-seeds torch.manual_seed AND re-draws the 6 val scenes (build_dataset uses cfg["seed"]+1000 for the val split, solver line 246) and the warm-start RNG. If SSIM stays ~0.9462 hr 0 under a completely different RNG draw + different val-scene sample, that CONFIRMS the 0.9462 ceiling is structural and seed-invariant -- a property of the method+substrate (6-param BF vs 2304-view FBP, half-view N2I info loss), NOT a lucky seed or a favorable single draw of the val set. A flat result is the SUCCESS condition for this probe (it bounds the result). It is NOT expected to clear hr>0 and is NOT intended to: it adds no capacity and does not change the optimization regime, so by construction it cannot escape the ceiling -- it can only document its stability. Everything else held at iter-1 (warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, train_n=200, val_n=6, n_iter=400, grad_clip=1.0, lr=5e-3, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=1, default img+proj sigmas). Per-image N2I (commit 1f4c3394): short amortized warm-start pre-pass then per-scan Adam fit on each val scan's OWN half-angle measurements (GT-free), scored by evaluate_calibrated on the SAME L277 val scenes as every other Mayo method. NOT amortized train-then-forward. Wall <=15 min (val_n=6, iter-1 ran 469s).
